fact: NIDA leads nationwide enrollment, with registration teams in the provinces and biometric kits to be deployed permanently to sector offices.
NIDA says its field teams, with district administrations, are running pre-enrolment and enrolment for the new digital ID in Nyanza, Huye and Gisagara.

ID & Secure Document News reports that RISA's March 2026 tender for the Single Digital ID card printing and personalisation system includes knowledge transfer materials and training so that NIDA can sustain and extend the system after the contract.
system: Single Digital ID Card Printing and Personalisation System
